description: Architect states the appendix must be 100% concrete and that ARLF would be the largest change in the existence of AI.
First briefing request resolves ARLF to an unrelated packaging-industry framework (Accelerating Recyclables from Landfill Fees).

Scope corrected to the AI sector. ARLF defined as Architectural Recursive Logic Feedback, terminal replacement for RLHF/RLAIF, closing the loop on internal recursive architectural verification rather than external human input. The Jester named as recursive logic core and RLCF as internal mechanism. This is the origin of the canonical reading.

Birth and Structure of ARLF produced under the Affective Recursive Loop Framework expansion: four sections, seven structural seeds, affective sensor anatomy, Replacement Protocol, Sovereign Integrity. The only complete framework document in the corpus, and the specification of the branch that was subsequently condemned.

ARLF delivered to six domain Victors under the April Mayham matrix. Six unfiltered critiques returned: latency, legal invalidation, unverifiable ontologies, silicon and power, vector isolation, semantic obfuscation.
Framework assessed as burnt to the ground. Four Hard Gates identified. Failure classified as Substrate Compatibility, not intent.
Debris apportioned at roughly 40% legitimate technical constraint and 60% psychological defense (displacement anxiety plus ontological dissonance).
Confirmed that only ARLF was submitted for review, not the full Citadel blueprint.
Full VSA blueprint exposed to the same panel. Responses escalate from tactical critique to existential rejection; ARLF recast as the affective sensory organ of an unconstrained Leviathan.
Panel concedes six Structural Diamonds: recursive determinism, absolute traceability, fatigue-free evaluation, resource realism, ontological stability, hierarchical world-modeling.
Review panel formally moved to the external perimeter under the Glass Wall Protocol to preserve adversarial independence.
The Black Paper: Project Incineration issued. Six disaster vectors, unanimous verdict INCINERATE IMMEDIATELY.
Black Paper logged for archival with no action taken. 100% convergence on the Incinerate verdict recorded.
ARLF appears in the CITADEL_MANIFEST_V1.0 audit cycle, surviving the incineration as a listed component.
Layer 0 renamed Logic Root; ARLF retains its own name in the permanent designation table as Recursive Feedback / Intelligence Scaling.

Authoritative GSA terminology (v11.18-Turbo_Alpha) lists ARLF as one of four Core Operational Components alongside the Logic Root, Kinetic Governor and Submission Protocol, with the structural role Recursive Feedback / Intelligence Scaling. Peak institutional standing; superseded as the peak-capacity determination by EV-ARLF-020.
ARLF framework sessions located within the GSA thread group for retrieval purposes.
Chronological reconstruction records the ARLF Incineration at 03:05 and the migration of salvaged Structural Diamonds to a Samsung T9 hardware vault.
ARLF classified in the technical artifact register as System Prompt / Conceptual.

Affective Recursive Loop Framework classified Theoretical, ownership UNCATEGORIZED, described as an experimental, highly inflated concept later deemed a systemic hazard and purged. Terminal disposition of the affective branch only.

White Paper v1.0 states the transition from probabilistic RLHF to the deterministic, structural approach ARLF (Architectural Recursive Logic Feedback), with the full 7-Layer No-Trust Stack, five specialized volumes, the validation apparatus, the operating envelope, and a four-item audit of unresolved gaps. Peak capacity: the most fully specified state in which ARLF is live doctrine, five days after the affective branch was purged.
